generated.details: The plain ivory ceramic plate has a shallow recessed center and a gently raised continuous rim.
The croissant rests inside the rim, its curved tapered ends joined through a plump center of overlapping golden flaky layers.
Its padded back panels have stitched seams and attach to a continuous concealed bench frame across the table, facing the screen.
Behind it, the cream glazed tile wall consists of slightly uneven rectangular tiles separated by narrow grout joints.
